reviews.title: False confidence and wasted money. I demand a refund!
reviews.text:
I paid the full price for this app to properly prepare for my exam. I honestly completed absolutely every question and practice test available. The program showed my passing probability at 98%, literally guaranteeing success and convincing me I was fully prepared.

In the end, I failed the actual learner's permit exam. The wording and many of the questions on the real test were drastically different from what this program prepared me for. The app just gives you false confidence, drills you on outdated phrases, and fails to serve its main purpose.

I wasted not only my money but also my time having to retake the test. I demand a full refund because the app absolutely does not live up to its promises. I strongly do not recommend this—do not waste your money.
